Name: Starbling Valley
Author: war77
Description:
[img width=849]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50414/50414-1786241124-1615130982.png[/img]

By default, Starbling Valley gives:

[code]+1 friendship point per placed furniture/decor item[/code]
It counts Stardew
[code]Furniture[/code]placed [b]outside on your Farm[/b] and [b]inside your FarmHouse[/b]. That includes things like paintings, chairs, tables, rugs, lamps, decorative furniture, etc.; it does not count machines, chests, crops, fences, paths, or unrelated placeable objects.
So your example works like this:

[code]Painting:        +1
Decoration:      +1
--------------------
Decoration bonus +2 FXP[/code]
If you're using Starbling Valley by itself, talking to an NPC for the first successful conversation of the day will show:

[code]+2 FXP[/code]
That is [b]only the decoration bonus[/b], not Stardew's normal friendship gain.
With [b]FOTP v2.0.1 or newer[/b], the two mods cooperate. If the pet is actively following and FOTP would normally give:

[code]+20 FXP[/code]
while your decorations provide:

[code]+2 FXP[/code]
you'll get one combined popup:

[code]+22 FXP[/code]
rather than two overlapping popups. If your pet is home or using [b]Stay![/b], FOTP contributes nothing and Starbling Valley shows its own
[code]+2 FXP[/code]normally.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Unzip the .zip into the Mods folder like other mods.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Adds a FXP display over NPC's heads for all extra FXP due to decorations and furnature.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]NONE[/color]
